# SRELL dependency

Unicode-aware incremental search uses SRELL 2026.06 (header version 202606).
Upstream: https://www.akenotsuki.com/misc/srell/en/

Imported without modifications from the source mirror
https://github.com/data-man/SRELL at commit
08bee31efee425b0858965bea02cbf546f1269b3.
The upstream release archive was unavailable (HTTP 403); this is a pinned
mirror snapshot, not an independently verified copy of that archive.

Required headers are srell.hpp, srell_ucfdata2.h and srell_updata3.h.
The BSD-2-Clause notice in license.txt must accompany binary distributions.
No target-specific runtime dependency or system installation is required.
